page_title: RMA 2-0 BET | Real Madrid v Betis 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Good movement by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Endrick (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Rui Silva.
89' Substitution. Rodrygo will be replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
88' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
88' Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight and sees a foul from Romain Perraud (Betis).
86' Half-chance! Assane Diao (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack.
86' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will take a corner kick.
84' A substitution has been made. Kylian Mbappe goes off and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) comes on.
83' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli is replaced by Juanmi (Betis).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Fornals trots off the pitch and is replaced by Iker Losada (Betis).
79' Vitor Roque (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The referee blows for a cooling break.
75' 2 - 0 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Rui Silva to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
75' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' It’s a PENALTY to Real Madrid after the VAR review!

74' Play continues despite the shouts by some Real Madrid players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
74' PENALTY APPEAL after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Assane Diao (Betis) replaces Rodri.

67' 1 - 0 Goal! Federico Valverde shows great vision to find Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
66' Substitution. Ferland Mendy makes his way off the pitch and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
65' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replacing Dani Ceballos.
65' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Javier Alberola Rojas lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
64' Rodri (Betis) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
64' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Thibaut Courtois comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Betis take a short corner kick.
63' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) inside the box.
62' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
62' Vitor Roque (Betis) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

61' Vitor Roque (Betis) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Thibaut Courtois. This effort didn't really trouble him.
59' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Javier Alberola Rojas's book.
58' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
58' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
57' Substitution. Johnny Cardoso (Betis) on for William Carvalho.
57' Here is a change. Aitor Ruibal is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Vitor Roque (Betis).
56' Rui Silva pulls off a great save to deny Rodrygo (Real Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
53' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Diego Llorente (Betis) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
52' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
50' Flag goes up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pablo Fornals (Betis).
49' The attendance is 70072.
48' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
48' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
47' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
46' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
45+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+3' Rodri (Betis) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul.
45+2' Betis are ruled offside.
45+2' Romain Perraud (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' The referee blows his whistle as Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
41' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola Rojas no option but to blow his whistle.
40' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kylian Mbappe.
38' A dangerous looking corner kick from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
38' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
34' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:3.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
28' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
26' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
25' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
24' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Rui Silva.
23' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
22' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Rui Silva makes a simple save.
21' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
20' Real Madrid win a corner.
19' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
13' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
12' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

12' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) latches onto a lofted pass from Romain Perraud on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
9' Romain Perraud (Betis) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
6' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Rui Silva intercepts the ball.
5' A spell of possession for Real Madrid in an attempt to control the game.
4' Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game. One of the players from Betis won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
